You hold the heart, yet the coral lives. Once I saw it was dying, I had no choice but to merge myself with the coral. We are one now: one tree with the same roots.
One day, I will visit the Tribunal Temple in Deshaan.\n\nI will hear the word of Vivec from his own lips.
Remember, subdue, then use the whistle. If you don't, they'll just start fighting again.\n\nI'll be at my mine, west of town. I've got to salvage what I can.
Ah, do you have what <<1>> needs? He's in the temple.
When you go for the banners, watch for the guards on the towers.
Yes! That just might work ….\n\nFind the skulls and bring them to Khralek's altar. We may be dead, but we still have power. We can pull Khralek to you.
Captain Hjolm?
Move along, traveler—unless you have news about Vartis Dareel.
Watch yourself. Tangling with Orcs is dangerous work.
Do you have enough <<z:1>>?\n\nSee <<2>> in the temple. He knows what to do with it.
<You've taken the items in this chest.>
I've sent dispatches to locate Scout Fontbonne. I'll let you know when we've found him.
You return. What did you learn?

With your assistance, I can focus on preparations for the coming plague. I wish I could be of more help, but I'm afraid I don't have much to offer.\n\nMy advice? Keep your eyes open and talk to the villagers.
Our guar barns are south of here. Burn the barrel of brandy, get his attention, and butcher him like the animal he is.\n\nThen bring me the antidote so that I can save my mother. Please!
Leel-Vata is my second sun. She gives me light and warmth in a world that is all too often cold and grim.\n\nPlease, see her back to me safely.
Make his death quick, please. He is still my egg-brother.
The acolytes await. Get moving. I doubt they have the fortitude to remain in position for long.
The Daedra you will face are fearsome. Be prepared.
Please get the antidote to Lady Drathyra.\n\nQuickly, before Matriarch Saalu passes!
Arrogant dryskin! Meddling in the affairs of the Saxhleel.
It's true. I was cowering here, but I was hoping you would survive the entire time.\n\nUm, did you learn how to bind Balreth?
Defend the hall!
We're in the heart of the cave, friend. Now is the time to strike.\n\nWhat do you say? Think we're mighty enough to take on the Goblin Warlord and his spider queen?
Go! Go! Don't worry about me. Get the Tear!
Shor's bones, you have to help! \n\nAggh. Miserable Gobs.
Back so soon? I wouldn't expect it could be quite that simple.
The guardians are in place. Good.\n\nNow we can finish this.
You have the antidote for Saalu?\n\nPlease, make for the western cave with all speed.
Ah, you again! I'm sure there are uses for your skills here.
Martin's my older brother, so I've looked up to him ever since I was just a child. \n\nSomehow, someday, I know he's going to change his ways, whatever path he chooses in life.
Well done, my friend. Now where's <<1>>? My axe thirsts for his blood.
Well met, friend. What brings you to Fork Virak?
Make your way through the broken wall, my wispy friend. Find a way to unlock the door from the other side.
Our guar are scattered throughout the sulfur pools to the south.\n\nThey won't return without the reminder of a harness around their necks. And dead guar don't need harnesses anymore.
I knew a woman would successfully navigate the Coiled Path.
Our fate rests in your hands.

Frankly, I'm surprised the Shornhelm Guard is willing to take on such riff-raff. \n\nIf Martin doesn't take the deal Captain Thayer's offering, he deserves to rot in the stocks—for dull wittedness, if nothing else.
You'll really collect the graven caps I need?\n\nThank you, traveler.
I see you returned, but with empty hands. We're only going to get so many chances, so be more careful this time.
Did you tell Bala to come to me? I wonder where she is?\n\nI can't wait. This will be so amusing!
I wonder if that stupid Ashlander got lost. Perhaps one of the guardians murdered her.\n\nEanen, that lowborn is leering at me. Kill it or something!
Why are you here? Go to Rhavil's house. \n\nEven now, that Covenant witch may be warning him that he's been found out.
Listen. You need to let me out of here. Don't tell anyone, and I'll make sure that you get rewarded. Just let me and my wife leave for Mournhold.
I swear I can't seem to finish a job without you showing up to complicate matters.\n\nJust give me a moment, would you? I'm right in the middle of something here.
It seems we have proof that the Dres are trying to murder our tree.
Good luck in your travels, warm-blood.
Almalexia bless you for getting those people to safety. \n\nNow head back to Merarii. By now, she doubtless has some new idea of how to deal with this curse.
There's nothing more to be said. Please do this for me, stranger.
Hold it right there. This is Duke Nathaniel's personal library. No access without his express permission.

The entrance to the ruins is beyond the northern gates. Look for a strange door set in the mountain wall.\n\nMadras and the others went on ahead, but you should be able to catch them. I'm sure they'd welcome your help.
If you get taken by the Maulborn, don't come to us for help. I'm sure House Hlaalu will save you.
It looks like the rats are moving in.\n\nI appreciate your help in this. Now no one will get hurt.
I don't believe we have anything else to discuss.\n\nYou're on your own. Good hunting.
The merchant now serves the Ghost Snake. It's an honor, though he probably doesn't appreciate it.
Hrmph! Well, you're not half-bad, I'll give you that.
I … can't hold him … much longer. Use the altar now!
Woof! Ha ha ha! Good fight! \n\nYou'll have to find someone else to brawl with. I just need a moment to catch my breath. And stop the bleeding. And get another mead. You know how it is.
<<1>> made a <<2>>? Great!\n\nCan you use it to help the survivors?
What have you decided to do?
I've never heard of anything like this happening in a kwama mine before.
I can feel the blessings upon you. It's a power I've not felt myself for many years.
What are you doing down here?
I saw that Covenant captain making for the gate. That was kind of you. In fact, you were kinder than I might have been.
I sense change. The curse retreats, broken. You've succeeded?
The souls are assembled. It is well.\n\nTalk to <<1>>. Then we'll begin.
All is prepared.\n\nTalk to <<1>>. Then we'll begin.

Varon and I will work on a cure, but meanwhile I need you to destroy the shipments. We can't let the plague reach Mournhold.\n\nRendezvous with the archers. They're outside the top of the cave, on an overlook.
Hold there. Visitors to Tal'Deic Fortress must adhere to protocol. We have very strict rules here.
Find the missing scouts. We'll need every blade in our attack on the Maulborn.
Thank you for choosing the Foozle. Please, hand it over now.
The clarity with which two words appear in your head is astounding, "Piss off."
Don't worry about me, I'll be fine. A little scrape won't kill me.\n\nI'd feel better if I got some of my cargo back, along with the manifest. The raiders captured it, took it up the hill.
I knew you'd help us. May the Three guide your weapons.

Fear not, we're the same people we were before we gained this … affliction.\n\nYears ago, a terrible sickness swept through our lands. I had to do something to keep my people safe. It's why I made a deal with the Daedra.
Raston never returned. I'm not sure how long we'll stay here.
Tarry no longer. The vicecanons await your introduction in the Guild Hall.
I didn't know <<1>>, but <<2>> named him a good man. Damn these murders!
I'll be waiting in the stables. Try not to get murdered.
<<1>> thinks we can learn something from the Worm Cultists, but I know fanatics when I see them.
Find their commander in the camp east of town. Make them understand the error of crossing House Dres. Be my hand of vengeance!
Rescue the grandmaster's son. With Sen Dres free, we can retake Kragenmoor from the Vanguard.
Nothing would please me more than the deaths of all these necromancers.\n\nI might tell you why later.
Go tell Ulov to meet me in the stables. Then use that totem at the altar near the pumpkin patch.\n\nWhether the monster is killed or not doesn't matter to me. My life is done.
The Trial of the Mind begins in the chamber below.
You've passed the trials. It's a rare thing you've accomplished.
<<1>> will know what to do, I'm sure of it.
You bear the Hist amber? Then you must rouse Hissmir's true power. The Zaht stones await you.
You're on your way to becoming an extraordinary smith. \n\nTo progress to the level of journeymen I need you to learn a few more recipes, gather more materials, and practice your craft.
I can't believe you brought Omalor out for us.\n\nOh, I'm going to enjoy this.
Many have died upon the Coiled Path. Likely, you will die, too.
Banishing a dro-m'Athra is as hard as calling it. Once you've empowered the totem with dead spirits, speak to Ruvali. \n\nRa-shadda must speak to her first. This one must see what can be said.
Last-to-Water's not a kind or loving father, but he's family. Loyalty does not end when the egg cracks.\n\nPlease rescue him.
Thanks for covering—I mean, thanks for getting me out of that cage so I could wreak havoc on the Maulborn.
Saryvn here has told me an interesting story. Care to elaborate?
The flies are the worst. It's not the bites. It's the incessant buzzing.\n\nI'll go mad by the time I get out of these shackles.
I'll remain here to protect what relics are left. To guard these pieces of our heritage … such a strange thought.
You haven't introduced yourself, outsider. I don't care if you're brave or foolish. Don't waste my valuable time.\n\nState your purpose. Why should you stand before One-Eye?
Be careful in those ruins. No telling who these mysterious others may be.
Where have you been? Where's the General?
What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
I fear something horrible has happened to those poor travelers.
Be prepared, outsider. The Sentinels fight to win.
Beatings, extortion, taking whatever they damn well please. Someone should stand up to those thugs.

You're carrying a great deal of medicine. That's good, but I have no use for it here.\n\nYou'll need to go south. Give the supplies to the farseer within Iliath Temple. She'll tell you what to do with them.
That High Elf won't wait forever. Get in there before she suspects anything.
The vicecanons won't do anything. I can't believe it!
You're back! And you're not full of stinger holes.
I hope you found Gethis. None of this should happen to such a good man.
Choose well, traveler.
You'll find the keystone within the Temple of Sul. You must obtain it before the Dominion.
Time we get to work, yes? Won't be long until the Dominion learns Tsanji is dead. Then they'll take their treasure and run.\n\nThat's bad for both of us.
Remember, just taking the resonators isn't enough. You also need to disable the repair stations.
Whoever's behind the murders appears to be resourceful. Take care you don't end up the next victim.
It doesn't have to end like this. Not with another slaughter. Not with more blood between us.

Now that you have a writ from the Great Moot you should study your profession under your new master. It will be hard, no doubt about it. Stick to it and you might mean the difference between success and defeat in Cyrodiil!
<<1>> and I are going to rest before we brave the road to Mud Tree.\n\nMaybe you should rest, too. You don't look so well.
You've seen me up here, writing? Letters sent, but not returned. Why do I keep writing to him if he doesn't care?\n\nPerhaps the mire has finally taken him. I've been sending letters to a corpse.
May the Three watch over you. From what I've been hearing, if anyone could find our missing vicecanon, it's you.
You must summon the guardians. We'll handle the Scamps. We'll meet you at the top. \n\nWalks-in-Ash should already be there. She's always been a stealthy sort.
The wind has carried you here with your scales unburnt.\n\nWhat do we do now?
Shor's bones! \n\nClosing those caves saved lives! We're all in your debt.
Once she has grown bored with her Altmer lover, she'll discard him for another. \n\nAnd like a man-eating beast, she has grown a taste for mortal attentions.
You've caused enough trouble!\n\n<<1>> will hear of this! You were sent here to upset my wife! Begone, before I lose my temper.
The acolytes await your assistance. Speak to them as soon as you can. I fear for their safety.
We're not dead. Amazing!\n\nI need a little time to recover. Go speak to Vaama and get that other Daedric essence.
That worked! And no strange side effects.\n\nQuickly now. Go to the other ruin and speak to <<1>>.
We are gathering the essences of these Daedra. Speak with the acolytes. They know how to summon them.
Your help dealing with those Supernal Dreamers was greatly appreciated.
Thanks again for your help, friend.
Thanks again for recovering the shards.  My wizard says it will be mended soon.
I see you rescued my son. He is a good boy, if a bit… incapable.
Thanks for returning my crystal. You have no idea how much that thing is worth. Certainly more than you'll ever earn in your life.
The cave ahead is probably the best approach, as the path to the north goes through the center of the Hollow and right into the thick of Vox's forces. \n\nDestroy the three wards, blessed one!
Speak to my father. He's been asking for you.

How many of those torchbug-gobblers did you flatten? I bet it was half a dozen.\n\nWait, you still have the <<z:1>>? Quick, get it to Chieftain Suhlak! If Clavicus Vile lifts his curse while you still hold it, you'll die for good!
Hurry to the Tribunal Temple. Don't keep the Sacred Lady waiting.
I'm terribly sorry, I can't spend more time chatting. There are a lot of people waiting for registration who don't have the same clout as you do.
Vivec's trial will measure your clarity of judgment. He saw our blessed people through vexing times. His wisdom reveals the secrets others keep.\n\nSo shall yours be put to the test.
I'm sure one of the other aides told you to talk to <<1>>. He's in the center of town.\n\nIt's the way we do things here, stranger.
You look new here, stranger. I hope one of the other aides directed you to speak with <<1>>.\n\nYou can find him in the center of town.
Wha … was I sleeping? I saw an Argonian waif, crying for help.\n\nMy head feels like it's trying to leave my body. I need to sit down.
You've made us proud today.
Head to the front line. See what you can find. We'll speak when you return.
Welcome to the Daggerfall Mages Guild. What can I do for you on this day blessed by the Eight?
Those Elven blackguards deserve every bit of trouble that comes to them.
I … where am I? Do you hear it? The voice is gone. It's gone!\n\nBy the Lord General's sword! How long was I out?
How did I get this far into the ruins?\n\nThe Goblin totem! Where is it? I need it!
I … I am awake, aren't I? This is real. Isn't it?
You've got the missing stone fragments? Let's see if we can activate it, then. You go ahead.
I can't believe our guards were slain by the Worm Cult! How will we make it safely to Mud Tree?
If those guards were slain by the Worm Cult, their spirits must be freed. I shudder to think of what those necromancers will do with them.
You are kind. I don't think every sister tests her brother this way, but it has always been so with me and Pash-Riha.
Seven-Bellies would be pleased if I crawled back into an egg. Then he could sit on it and protect me.\n\nHis concern is not lost on me, but after I hatched, I'd still bite his tail.
Follow the gorge to the east and climb to the ruins. \n\nFight well.
You've done much to help us, but all may yet be undone.\n\nThe storage tunnel is just behind the temple. Seek out <<1>>. He'll be leading the defense. Help him keep our enemies at bay.
Welcome to the Fighters Guild! You look like the capable sort. Why have you come? Are you here to answer the Guildmaster's challenge?
Good luck in there. Remember, don't let anyone see you!
Let me take these goods back to my family, so they don't starve.
I hope my loose guar aren't causing any trouble.\n\nKeep it up! There are a few more out there.
The yard is secure. Once again, the Pact controls Fort Virak. \n\nYet <<1>> still lives. Where is he? He has much to answer for.
If you can find that bow, <<1>> would appreciate it.
What are you waiting for? Light the fire.
Good thing you came along when you did. I'm pretty sure they were preparing more unconventional methods of extracting information, if you know what I mean.
This is beyond what we usually handle. But the Shadowscales are up for any task.
We don't understand the full power of the keystones. Even one might give the Dominion terrible power.
Without you, we'd have been food for the <<mz:1>>.
The Dominion still hasn't found the keystone, you should still be able to swipe it under their nose.

Got your pickaxe? Head into the Ashlanders' tunnel and use it to weaken the supports. We'll hold them off here.\n\nI won't wish you good luck. Only children and Altmer rely on it. I'd rather trust in your skill.
Dolril's safe, at least. Thank you for returning him to us.\n\nNow there's nothing to do but wait for these Ashlanders to grow tired of killing and leave.
I heard fighting below. Are you all right?
I said I would turn the stuff in and I will. Though I still think it's a waste.
You threaten Vox, enraging her, forcing her to commit even more brutal atrocities! How glorious!\n\nSoon her army of Daedra and lost souls will march forth, unleashing new terrors across the land.
I never liked bugs. Now I positively hate them!
As I said, the other vicecanons broke away at the first sign of fighting. I don't know where those spineless cowards are, but we need to regroup if we're going to have a chance at this.
<<1>> was a sight to see, coming out of that cave. She makes a pretense of frailty, but she stood shoulder to shoulder with the rest of her troops. Such valiance is a rare trait in politicians.
Thank you for stopping <<1>>'s imposter. He deserved no less.
Can't … move! Help me!
Uhhh, uhhh!
My arms and legs won't work! Sep's blood, I don't want to be eaten by baby snakes!
Argh! It burns! It burns!
Just remember, this doesn't make us partners!
No sign of <<1>>, but the Nord over there is definitely a skin-stealer. I know what he's planning to do with those prisoners. If I help out, you'll tell nobody about my Daedric relic-hunting, yes?
Now that you're here, we'll take the fight to the mountain. To Tanval.
The gatekeeper is the only thing standing in our way.
That faithless harlot! How dare she hone in on my deal!
You've completed my trial, mortal. Seek my colleague on the stairs above the caldera.
You're no fool to withhold your trust. Commendable, truly. But you'll go no further without my help.\n\nDestroy these bindings and free me!
I can sense the spirits with you, my friend.
Did the spirits talk to you? What did they say?
Find a way to kill <<1>> and I'll reward you handsomely.
Ho there! Shanked anyone lately?
My mother and brother are safe, and I have you to thank. Praise the Three they survived.
No! Not father…\n\nHe was the best man I ever knew.
No words but her words!
Back away, outsider.
You're the help <<1>> sent? Looks like he finally did something right.\n\nWelcome. I'm Saervild Steel-Wind, Vicecanon Hrondar's deputy.
That can't have been an easy decision. Prisoners freed into the fens? Who knows what they'll do with their freedom?\n\nI received a message. The Dominion finally made their move against <<1>>.
I was trapped. I let myself get trapped. Perhaps I would even be dead. You changed that, friend.\n\nUnderstand: I'm grateful, but I also wish you had never found me.
You grow used to the ointment's smell after a while. You didn't get any in your eyes, did you? Good, good.
Made it out alive, I see. How did it go?
We're too late. The keepers have fallen.
Did you talk to Mavos?
Are you insane? Don't you know what taking those relics will do to the dreugh?
She speaks. She speaks!
We finally made it. I thought we were done for, once or twice.\n\nBefore you take the keystone, there's something you must know.
I think we have all the pieces. Place the skull with them to restore the reliquary.

Amazing work, my friend. Now Dithis and I can deconstruct the Goblinization matrix and see where I went wrong. Perhaps some sort of magical attraction component was added by mistake. \n\nSo Dithis … do you feel pretty?
I've decided to leave Dithis as a Goblin for a few days. Hopefully, it will remind the brothers of what happens when they meddle in magic they don't understand.
I can't thank you enough for saving me from <<1>>. I'm going to suffer through this humiliation as long as I need to. At least I'm alive!\n\nAnd stop looking at me like that, Denthis.
Assistant, you know better than to ….\n\nYes, I think I see. What brings you to me, "Assistant?"
Please, we must take the eggs to safety!
You can't fight all the spirits here. Subdue a few. The rest may follow.
The urge to plunge your hand in fire, to spill your own blood? My whisper in your ear, supplicant. Know that I made you the instrument of my will.
I'm dry with apprehension, comrade. Everywhere, I smell musty rot.\n\nIt is different than the rot of the swamp. It makes my scales itch.
We haven't heard from my brother yet. I hope he is well.
Ah, my friend from Davon's Watch!. Interested in more work?\n\nI've located another rare vintage here in Ebonheart.
Speak to the grandmaster if you truly wish to help us.
Don't worry about me. Plenty more must die before my revenge is complete.
If you can get this mess sorted out we'll be back to business as usual and I won't have to listen to any more of <<1>>'s moaning.
Comrade, I'm glad you're going with <<1>>. Her passion to discover Doshia's goal is all-consuming. I fear it will cloud her judgment. \n\nStendarr watch over you both.

Who knows what <<1>> thought she was after? What clawless fool records her plan in a journal?\n\nAelif would like to point out that the Dwarves believed in nothing. What would they know of Molag Bal's plot?
You're looking for the keystone?\n\nI can tell you with absolute certainty it's not here.
How fares the hunt?
Here, take the antidote. Keep it close. Don't use it unless you feel her poison take effect.
Lost your spider? Vivec's sake. Go get another one.
You heard Merric, new blood. Search those bodies. Aelif will check this one.
Praise the Hist. You return safely! You have something with our enemy's scent?
Now that Vox's forces are weakened, victory is within our grasp.
Welcome back. Something I can do for you?
The Shadowscales want the Fangs of Sithis! There are so many of them ….\n\nBut they're dangerous. The Fangs in the hands of assassins? I can't imagine anything worse.
You've got more guts than I have.
My assignments keep getting worse and worse.
Well done. Now that the portals are closed, we can clean up the remaining invaders.
After prayers, we'll clear out the remaining Daedra.
You've done the Guild proud, comrade.
I'm so glad to be out of there. Thank Stendarr you saved me from that vile creature.
I will pray to our master for your victory.\n\nTo Hermaeus Mora, He Who Holds the Paper to the Light!
Ready?
The Eye glares. The master calls for retribution.
I exist to serve. I can ferry you to Shad Astula whenever you are ready.
Father is going to have a hard time explaining this.
Search the library below and find the librarian. She hasn't responded to my calls.\n\nI fear something foul stalks my Academy.
Good luck, traveler.
I really owe you one.\n\nIf you get some free time, maybe we can meet for lunch or something.
Send it away! Send it away!
Hadmar will stay here for a while. It's not safe out there and I don't want to have my mind controlled. No, no, no.
Thanks for getting that <<1>>. Catch up with me at Ebonheart.\n\nI heard that another, shall we say, "collectible" wine is there.
Continue your journey, wherever your path leads.\n\nWe'll contact you once we know more.
Comrade, we must restore this weapon of old. Make ready for any new plots by the Prince of Lies. I feel the strength of Stendarr flowing through my arms. Are you prepared?
We'll leave once we've packed our things.
Cast Carethil out before it's too late.
Everything's ready for the blessing. All I need is the <<1>>, and then we can start.
You are ready to go back?
Why hasn't he come home? Where can he be?
Welcome to the hall, comrade! I bet you've got some good tales to tell of our war on the Anchors.
You brought my sweet Rulantaril to his senses.\n\nThank you, mortal. Now we can be together, forever and ever.
Don't eat any cooked trodh, Lukiul. Just tell me everything you hear about the sacred performance.\n\nAnd ignore anything you hear about a secret society, or a death sentence.
Which toll will you choose to pay? Toll of flesh hurts flying rats. Toll of silver makes us richer. Pay, pay!
You radiate an aura of power. Does this mean you have the books?
Be careful. <<1>> is not to be taken lightly. I lost the sanctuary because of his nimble tongue and mad stare.
Well, what is it? Here for some noble purpose, no doubt.
You! Our knave tells me you have chosen to pay the toll of silver! What say you?
An outsider in the Blackfeather Court. You must pay the toll!
The featherless one approaches.
Back work, it seems. I guess that's an improvement.
Tell Not-So-Quick he shouldn't drink the elixir.\n\nI know. Trust me.
Ow. I don't feel so good.
Kyne's breath! You've done it.
Not bad! All right, now I know the melody. What are the lyrics to this fancy song, mead demon?
So many proud warriors slain. We'll repay every drop of blood threefold.
The way is clear. Please, find the foreman. We'll hold the mine entrance and the town.
I don't mind chatting with you, but I'm sure you've got other things to do.
How goes the murder?
Say, I think you told me a whopper.
Stop <<1>> before it is to late.
I do hope you have success in killing Remelie.\n\nShe's had plenty of success in killing my guards.
As long as the Twilight Boss still lives we are all still in danger.
Ah, there you are. Took you long enough.
Here is your well-deserved reward.
<cough> Kill the beast or we will never be free from the threat of the Dreamers.
Shor's bones, I'm glad you're here. Look for my miners while you're exploring. They don't deserve this.
Please, help me!
I thought I was dead. Please, free me.
I don't want to die down here. What will my brother do without me?
The Reach are animals. Get me out of here!
I'll meet you at the tavern in Riften as soon as I can, my new friend.
Thanks for saving us! Good luck out there!
I don't care about <<1>> and her mine. I'm marching up to that camp, killing every Goblin I can find, and getting Hodmar's body back.\n\nI'll see his bones back in Skyrim or die trying.
<<1>> and I are going to rest before we brave the road to Mud Tree.\n\nMaybe you should rest, too. You don't look so well.
I'm almost afraid to touch <<A:1>>. Are we too late?
Let's wreak some havoc!
The thought of <<1>> alone in these ruins concerns me. She's no summer hatchling.\n\nDon't tell her I said that.
What happened? Where did you go?
Quick, give me the totem. I'll use it to lead the Goblins into the swamps. They won't bother anyone after that.\n\nSure, they're not civilized, but they don't deserve this abuse.
What happened to the vicecanon?
Help me, please. My partner is trapped in the mine! I can't bear the thought of anything happening to Adana down there.
You've found others, but not <<1>>? Don't give up, I can't bear the thought of continuing without him!
My sister is trapped in the mine! Raena is all I have left, after our father fell fighting the Reachmen. Please rescue her!

<<1>> already has your reward all counted out and ready to hand over.\n\nYou give me the totem, we go back to work, and these Goblins learn from the example of the Ebonheart Pact. That's better for all of us.
If anyone can work out how to end these … abominations, it's Belron.
<This cultist was killed recently. The body is still warm.>
With the shroud gone, we can follow you in!\n\nYou're looking a little dead around the edges. Let me take care of that.
Look for my fiancee, <<1>>. I've been away on business, and came home to this! I do not know if she lives or fell prey to one of those things!
Kill the Pact to end the act. Ha! I did it again, didn't I?
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Thank you for making this possible, my friend.\n\nNow let's move! This ruin isn't going to study itself!
You're Kyne-sent, traveler. Please.
This great furry horker didn't go down easily.\n\nAll I could think of were my girls.
My sister ran into the cave. Hurry!
Follow Father. We'll be right behind you.
Valaste awaits you at the Guildhall in Daggerfall, along the southern coast of Glenumbra.
Oh, my poor Tavo! What am I going to do without him?
I already owe you. But I'm hearing rumors. They need to be investigated.
I sense the <<1>> banished, but only for a trice. He shall return to mete out weighty punishment. \n\nI cannot destroy <<Az:2>>, but I beseech you do so. End the source of the <<1>>'s hold upon us!
I hope my daughter Milta is still alive.
<<1>> can't seem to decide whether to come home or not. Could you talk to him?
My brother still has not returned. I fear the Goblins did not greet him as he expected.
I fear my brother's idealism got the better of him. He still hasn't returned from the Goblin camp.
Isn't it beautiful? The most beautiful part of the chateau. You can see why I've held onto the place all these years.
Light that fire, soldier!
It's no use. Unless they're whole, the spirits of the departed can receive no comfort.
I'm going to have to head back to town soon, my friend. Lost a lot of blood.\n\nHow goes the hunt?
Skyshroud Barrows is northeast of the village. Send everyone you find back here. Good luck.
You should be able to get them out before they're a meal for spiders.\n\nWe shouldn't have come here. I should have listened to the guildmaster.
The undead are gone. What did you do?
May Arkay see us through these troubled times.
I stand once more at the seat of my power. I am a spectre, a mere shade, forced to watch as a necromancer defiles my body.\n\nKill him.
Damned necromancers and their crystals.
I feel like an idiot for trusting Ulrich so completely. I know better now.
Why are you still talking to me?
Two switches will shut these traps off. We need to hit them at the same time. \n\nGet the one on the far wall. I'll hit mine when you do.
I can't thank you enough for saving me. I'm no milk drinker, but those bandits could have sent me to Sovngarde with the flick of a wrist.
You haven't found all of them? Please keep looking, I know they're out there.
Goblins are pathetic beasts, but they have their uses.

Shalidor found you, excellent. I've puzzled out the hints from that last book … and I'm afraid the news isn't good. Your next trial is in a particularly nasty part of the Shivering Isles. A place called the Chateau of the Ravenous Rodent.
They're here! They're inside my heart and my head and my eyes! I can see them with all three!
<<<1>> makes a sad sound as he looks to the south.>
If Vantir's dead, please tell Diodore. No matter what I've said, he's nervous as a foal.
Watch out for the bandits' wolves. They'll sniff you out in a second.
I'll be honest, adept. I can barely stand to look at you. Sending an intelligent woman like Valaste off with that creature. But … I feel honor bound to offer you a final gift.
Ah! Good! You and I can have reasonable conversations. Shalidor's just too old and crotchety for me.
It is good Bera found you, comrade. The Bright Moons know Aelif is glad to see you again. She would trust no one else for the task before us today.
My work here is nearly complete, comrade. The core will soon be a weapon once again.
A Daedric titan is a formidable foe. They are the living siege engines of Molag Bal's invasion force. That you overcame one is testament to your strength.
While waiting to set sail is a thrill, please complete your business and let the captain know we're ready to go.
Head into the fort. Defend it from Covenant attackers.\n\nKyne watch your hide, friend.
I know, I know. You're not going to be yourself again until we find your <<1>>, but don't go back out there!
Please, find the others.
So grateful for your help. Keep up the search.
The others are on the edge of the dagger. Please.
I hope you have put many Daggers into the earth.
What a bloody, tragic business!
Comrade, I put my life in your hands. What is to be my fate?
How are the bees? The success of the meadery depends on their honey. It has to be perfect!
He left us no choice.
Kazok's head stuck on a pike will give the remaining Stormfists in the area something to think about!
For the glory of Yorgrim!
Collect one of the General's hairs and find a way to slip the sleep potion into his drink. I'll start preparing for the ritual.
I hope you're finding my <<1>> useful. \n\nLet me know how well they work for you.
Are you executing a contract at the moment?\n\nHeh. Executing.
Make sure you try some of Roruld's special batch. That's some damn fine mead!
Search around the house for a way in. I don't think you'll find a key under a rock, but you never know.\n\nI'll make sure this location is secure. Then I'll meet you over there as soon as I can.
Were you able to light the fires? That's the only way to warn Davon's Watch.
Those wolf pelts were very helpful. It's good to know that even vicious monsters can be useful after they're killed and skinned.

Kyne sent us a miracle, friend.\n\nThe witches barged in and I thought we were going to have to fight them. But they started tending to our wounds! They helped us and walked away. I don't understand any of this.
You only have two things left to do. One: find Keeper Ormi. Two: put a blade in her dark heart.\n\nIf that doesn't end the curse, at least it will make damn certain no one else gets bewitched.
I'll make sure no other travelers fall victim to the dark witches.\n\nWindhelm will send troops to wipe them out. I give you my word.
We'll make things right. You'll see.
Did the Fighters Guild send you? Has word reached the guild hall?
I'm glad I found you, Comrade. The guild has need of your … unique talents.
Hurry! To the Hall of Trials! You must protect King Jorunn at all costs.
Disgusting bug dog! Gena, are you sure you want to keep it?
There's no scent of the dead on you. Please hurry and check out that graveyard.
Thank you again. I actually think this has been good for me.\n\nIf you can't tame your own fear, how can you tame anything else?
A good race, but you were outclassed. Still, I'm always happy to see someone new perform so admirably.
Where's my banner? You promised to get it for me!
You brought my Crystal back.  Why are you still talking to me?
My own brother and the traitorous Stormfist clan? Here?\n\nI won't stand for this! Guards!
Were the Orcthane's agents dealt with?
Discover anything new about your mark?
Well, now we may be onto something, you've been looking around pretty well.
Now you're talking, looks like you have a line on this guy.
I'm sure Thane Mera will appreciate your assistance. And your discretion.
Perhaps a bit more intrigue will help. No, too many threads already.
Go after her! You may be our last hope at retelling the story!
You've returned? Does this mean <<1>> is safe?
I hope my father can attend the council meeting.

We finally decided to disobey Spinner Indinael, and it's a good thing we did! Endrith and I saw the cultists carrying a body inside the cave, here.\n\nWe have no weapons! We can't fight the least of the undead, let alone the cultists!
My death is the beginning of a new story, and not a happy one, I fear.\n\nI feel the pulse of the Worm Cult. I must resist.
Spinner Indinael needs help!
Well played! Now place the offerings on the altar behind me.
Lucky you came along when you did! We've got a lot of work to do.
Farewell.
The Emissary of Z'en! My prayers are answered! She'll strike down the Drublog and end all of this!
All this blood and violence. By the Nine Holds, I need a drink.
I can't wait for the bard to sing a song. Isn't he handsome?
The bard returned, telling a strange tale about an enchanted lute. He seemed quite distraught.
You must enter the crypt beneath my father's manor and put an end to his plots and schemes.

As soon as I get this lift working, I'll meet you down there. Just watch out for the constructs. These ruins are always full of constructs.\n\nAnd if you spot the lore vault, please tell Kireth. That's what she's down there looking for.
And so the story ends, mortal. Your part in the balance won't be forgotten.
That bard returned. The tale he told us was frightening, but he had good things to say about you.
This place will never be the same again.
I'm very sorry about what happened.
I never asked for this, any of this. Why can't I live as I choose?
The story came close to destruction thanks to the Hound's interference.\n\nAnd now, he can never change a story as ageless as that of the Silvenar and the Green Lady.
Did you come here to learn about the life of the Green Lady?
What do you think? We've only got the one orb you found.
You look like you need a bear steak. Charred on the outside, bloody in the middle!
Why must I cook for the unrefined palate?

We need to attract Rilis' attention, and retaking the binding stone that was his prison is sure to alert him. It's just up ahead.\n\nMount an assault to secure the stone and he's sure to make an appearance. Defeat Rilis, and we will contain him.
Sounds like you have orders from another ranking officer, my friend. Get going.
Greetings in his name. Always happy to have new faces join us. Especially from Hammerfell!

Find my son and end his life. And do it quickly.\n\nThe power I gave should aid you in the coming battle. Valeric may not be as strong as I am, but my blood runs through his veins. Underestimate him at your own peril.
I can't believe I slept through the attack.
The way is clear, friend of the Silvenar!
Well met, champion.
They're … the tribes assembled. Too much for us.
If you have nothing to do, talk to <<1>>. Try to avoid bothering those who are busy.

What I wouldn't give for the power to kill that raving bastard!\n\nHe's been watching us, and mentions the Daedra to mock me. How glorious it would be to turn them against him, use the Daedra for good.
I wish you luck and I hope you can save your king. May the Three Old Gods guide you.
Keep an eye on <<1>>. He'd light himself on fire if he got half a chance.
Get me out of these bonds, quickly! If I know her, she'll be halfway to the next village before I catch up!
My wife is being held somewhere. Let's get moving.
The quicker we find a way out of here, the quicker we can rescue Sai. Let's go!
Ah, the brave and mysterious champion returns. Do you have something for me?
What do you want now?
At least I'll get a good scar out of this.

The poison pulls from Jorunn's memories and gives strength to his greatest fears. The death of his sister, the soldiers in his service, and Fildgor.\n\nHis dreams have created guardians to hide his true memories. You must show him the truth of things.

By the Pact, that was horrible! I could feel his spirit energy draining away!\n\nI can't believe you chose to sacrifice Raen, but I won't waste his gift. I'll do whatever I can to rescue the Silvenar and help you.
That's a hard decision, friend.\n\nI'll do what I can in Sariel's memory to help you rescue the Silvenar, lest her screams echo in my ears for eternity.
Tell Selgaard his wife waits for him. I will protect our home until he returns.
My bonds are broken! I'm free of that vermin-infested cave. Now to hunt down more of those damned cultists.
My colleagues killed or wounded, our work destroyed. This affront must be avenged.
My Treva. He came to me, spoke to me. Told me he was free of the Worm Cult's grip.\n\nThank you. May Kyne watch you on your travels.
Keep looking. We need to know more before we act!
You're through the barrier, yeah? Why are you wasting time talking to me? Get in there.

I am <<c:1>>, the spiritual advisor to … why, it's you! Wonderful.\n\nWood Orcs from <<2>> have captured me, and I don't know why. I am loath to impose upon your aid yet again, but I have nowhere else to turn.
We are victorious and the Ebonheart Pact is sealed.\n\nGo, inform my son that the battle is won. Have him prepare to take Fildgor to prison.
By storm and wind, we shan't let them pass. The future of the Dominion is in our hands. We will fight until the last one falls!
The Houndsmen and the Drublog, working together to destroy my connection to the land! I can't believe it.\n\nThankfully, you saved me.
Thank you again. You'll receive a glowing mention in my report on our ill-fated expedition.
Please, help. The Drublog ….
For a savage, you show promise. Just a bit, mind you.\n\nPerhaps one more act will earn you my respect.
What happened up there? I heard fighting!
I'm sure I don't have long to live. Netapatuu tells me my wounds are minor, but I know better. Oh, death would be better than this agony!
I knew you'd make it. Thallik lead the cultists into the barrow beyond. Good luck.
Valdur told me of your deeds at Taarengrav. \n\nNow our heroes have gathered, and we will need all of you to beat these damn Worms and take back what is ours!
Found any other strange materials for me to blow up?
Many more would grieve by the river today, if not for you. Thank you, my friend.
I never doubted this would happen, but the feeling of relief is overwhelming.\n\nThe celebrations continue for several days and nights, but the handfast is complete!
I'm glad you're on our side!
I don't know what magic summons the Guardian of Silvenar, but if you go to the bridge, it should appear. Defeat it, then head into the city.
Thank you for helping us.
No, it can't end like this! He promised!
We'll never forget your part in this story.
Celebrations will continue for many, many days.
I don't see my husband anywhere. This doesn't feel right.
The giants have finally calmed down, but I'm not sure I want to move back into Lower Yorgrim.
I can't believe things will end this way! They can't.
The handfast ritual is but one of the many ceremonies for this wedding.\n\nLook around, my friend. Without you, this joyous celebration could not be possible.
See you later, friend. Perhaps we'll meet again.\n\nIn fact, I hope we will.
After a tragedy like this, it may be best to abandon this place.
One of our strikers will meet you inside the cave.\n\nThe captain has an iron will, but I fear she won't hold out much longer, if the tales of <<1>> are true.
Both the Commander and Thod were heading toward the barracks. I'm sure you can catch up with them if you hurry.
Who knew party planning could be so much work! It's enough to drive Rigurt to drink. If only the mead had arrived.
Now that the meadery is back in business, I barely have enough time to eat and sleep.
You! What are you doing here? Let me guess. You're helping Rigurt again, aren't you?

The gates have been sealed since we arrived, but Lord Vurlop should be able to open them. \n\nKing Jorunn was adamant that no one disturb the meeting. I imagine that whatever they are discussing in there, Fildgor is definitely at the heart of it.
Excellent! You are here. And you are all fancy! All cultural and everything.
Arithiel did right by us. If it weren't for her, we wouldn't be alive.
<<1>>  still breathes. See to that.
The Worm Cult! Here?\n\nI don't have the forces to take down a cabal of necromancers. Is there anything you can do?
The shadow's lifted! For the first time in many moons, my spirit is my own. I can see my destiny again.\n\nWithout your help, the Silvenar might never have made it back. I hope I didn't injure you.
Yes! Finally! I'm sure the feast will be fantastic!
Why would anyone attack us? We never did anything to deserve this!
Move along.
You bring the magicka. Good luck!
I heard you went through the portal and defeated <<1>>. I can't thank you enough.
I heard you went through the portal and defeated <<1>>. I can't thank you enough.
My people should not suffer for any problems within my court. I should have seen Betar-Nes's treachery before it came to roost in my very hall.
Was that your first encounter with a Daedric Titan? No? You lead a charmed life, I see.
Got a cold greeting, eh? For what it's worth, I'd be glad of any help you give while you're here.
What's the delay?
So, did you find Sadri? Did you get the deed?
We showed Fildgor's minions what for! They won't come back here any time soon.
Bring back the head of the alpha troll to honor my people. Do what your Prince's guards refused to do.\n\nThen I'll consider speaking with the others again.

"Maybe we should go upstairs so I can protect you." Who even says that? He could have complimented my eyes! Or my … never mind.\n\nHe's one of Dhalen's thugs. No sign of the King, though. Not sure if that's a good thing or a bad thing.
Tell Aera I'm headed to Golun's place.\n\nThen enjoy Nimalten. More importantly, stay out of my damn way.
Hallfrida grew up knowing me as her father's advisor. Still she doesn't trust me. I'll have to fix her mistakes later, as I always have.
The nightmare begins again. You should have left sooner. Now you're trapped here with us, to the bitter end.
Have you learned anything more about the murder?
Found the captain, yeah? Ysgramor's strength stands before me.
You will be forever in our prayers.
Voranil lives. For now.\n\nWe are thankful for your help, stranger, but if I were you I would have fled long ago. The Keepers and I, we must stop Rilis—at any cost.
Good day, hero of Mournhold and Deshaan! I hate to interrupt your victory, but I'm here to request your assistance.
Is … is this my silk?
You can't know how grateful I am for this.
Did you find anything?
Thank you for your time and support. May I have the beads back?
<<1>>? I think I felt her! Did you find her?
You're not that bad, for an outsider.
I can't wait to see those losers' faces!
There were too many of them. They overpowered me and tossed me in here.
You! You must listen to me!
Companions, workers, find them and save them. Who am I forgetting? Oh, right. Did I mention how grateful my sister Kireth will be to see your face?
Thank you. We can't let the Worm Cult accomplish their goal here. We'll keep these survivors safe until you return.
So. What did the notes say? No rush. Take your time.
I didn't expect this outcome, to be honest. But there, you've done what you set out to do and saved Finoriell.\n\nGood.
So many sacrifices this day! But look! Finoriell was saved!
Why are you talking to me now? Finoriell's safe! Talk to her!
You and Lara saved me. I would be nothing, forgotten! What would that be like, to be … unmade like that?
It's been so long. I'm free. And you saved me. Thank you, liege-lord.
You've been a huge help to us. Many thanks.
My head feels like it's going to crack in two. But some things are clearer.
You've learned the tune, yes? Now we can move on to planning the performance.
We'll deal with Thorulf later. In the meantime, I know our soldiers can hold the walls. \n\nStill. Dark Elves defend. Nords attack.
She's waiting for you at the Rawl'kha Guildhall in Reaper's March. Good luck, comrade.
The Champion of Windhelm?\n\nIt takes more than winning a foot race and play fighting to make a true champion. A silly title. That's all it is.
Nimalten reminds me of Bleakrock. All these good people, oblivious to danger. If only we could have protected my family. \n\nHave you learned anything?
Leave this place and find <<1>>. I will meet you outside.
So you broke the Reach's lock on the mine entrance, nice. We'll hold them out here if you take them on inside the mine.
Good, the entrance should be unlocked now.
She's preparing a ritual space at the Rawl'kha Guildhall in Reaper's March. I'll see you there, Adept. We're so close!
I'll search for any other survivors who've escaped.
This is the end of the Bridge. Beyond lies Sovngarde, the realm of the honored dead.\n\nIt is not a place for the living. Turn back.
Through the caves, you will find the grove of insects. If you follow the story's path, you can't miss it.
Forward! We must reach <<1>>.
<<1>> is a mountain we must surmount. And you must lead us.
There is no time for failure. If you cannot lead us to <<1>>, we must find someone who can.
It was carrying a salmon? I wasn't fishing for salmon. The salmon fishing is done off the docks. That-a-way, beyond the warehouse.
Trolhetta has been a slaughterhouse. So many have fallen.
You've saved Velyn Harbor from devasation, and the Fists of Thalmor from a great embarrassment.\n\nSpeaking of great embarrassments, please talk to <<1>>.
The other traders are in the merchant stalls. For now, all we need is their word.
Soorba will follow you all over Velyn Harbor and fight at your side, but don't leave the area or she'll just come back to me.
It falls to us. We must rally the Companions and face Sinmur together. Are you with me?
Not a moment too soon!\n\nIt's as I suspected. The village is in considerable danger!
Hey there! I'm just preparing some oats for the horses. You need anything, you should talk to Afneer. He'll set you right.
If you aren't going to deliver what you promised, I have no further use for you.\n\nGo away. You're spoiling my bath.
Ho there. We've been hearing about your exploits from Veldrana. We're up here looking for a patrol from Riften that seems to have gone missing.
Is my nose still here? I think it may have snapped off.
You return. I am almost afraid to ask, but—what news?
I prayed for your safe return. It's good to be out under the open sky again.\n\nI hope … I hope Uricantar went down without much struggle.
Be careful. It seems <<1>> has gone quite mad.
I tried to stop him. I couldn't … I couldn't help them.
I … how … you … argh! I can't believe you beat me! No one ever beats me!
Point the bow the other way. Those arrows are dangerous.
They … came from nowhere. By boat, maybe. Never been this far inland. Captain Ciranya ….
You have a <<1>>? What are you waiting for? Get in there and destroy the beacon!
It isn't that I'm overly bloodthirsty, you understand, but I can't stomach betrayal. Kill one of those troublesome lieutenants and the other will get the point.\n\nI'll be here, nursing my wound.

These Maormer are far from home. \n\nAs a young lad, I heard many a tale of the Pyandonean pirates. I assumed they were apocryphal. Dreamed up to frighten children. I was wrong. They're every bit as bloodthirsty as the stories would have us believe.
The shallows in this bay are treacherous, but the Maormer navigated through those reefs like they've been doing it their whole lives.
<<1>>'s in bad shape, but he'll pull through.
Have you recovered it? Did you rescue Akatosh's claw from those brigands?
I should warn you. Three coins say Norion is down in the crypts.
A moment. I need all my concentration to do this.
The King's Arrow? Well met. Don't suppose you lead a vanguard of troops to Vernim?
You must banish Colonwe's spirit before I can perform the ritual!
The forging of the crystal with the lattice takes an extraordinary amount of discipline.
Let us do it. This outrage has gone on long enough.
Queen's favorite, I'm glad you're here. We came to Tanzelwil to honor the spirits of our ancestors, and now they seem bloody well determined to kill us all!
A mortal willing to right a mortal wrong. Intriguing, but we have been disappointed before.
Speak with my sister.
The rest of the crew's waiting beyond the cave's exit. I'll follow shortly, when I am sure we aren't being followed.\n\nNow go! Get the captain to safety.
Go on. I look forward to leading my crew far away from this terrible place.
Search the area for more of the stones and destroy them. Ancestral spirits usually don't try to kill their living descendants.
<<1>> brought the shards you'd retrieved into the ruins for the final battle.\n\nWith only two shards, you have little chance of defeating Sinmur by yourself.
A little busy here. I must keep this shield up.
Please be quick.
My aunt will be so disappointed when she gets the news.
Sorry. No time to talk.
Into the fray with one of the Five Hundred at your side. Make us proud.
The fires are under control, thanks to you.

It has been a long time, hasn't it? I hope you remember Walks-in-Ash, as well? She's out there in the field. Tending to the wounded out there. Forbade me from joining her, said I'm needed here. Damn her scales.
You've found the blade? Excellent.\n\nPut the ivory in the pit and let the ritual begin.
Hurry, the urns that bind me here must be destroyed!\n\nI'm coming with you. You need all the help you can get.
Best of luck up there. Those ruins are overrun with spirits. Not what I signed up for.
They've taken my lighthouse. It's the only life I know.
You're a right bastard, you know that? Still … maybe she needed less coddling. Get out of here, and make the Worm Cult pay for what they did to my brother.
That's done it! One less angry werewolf to plague Malabal-Tor!\n\nMany thanks! The other minstrels have accepted me again, and we're going to practice for the celebrations.
Grimclaw will never complain about our music again!
I don't know what everyone's so upset about! This is our big opportunity. Yes, we still need practice, but the celebration goes on for days! People will like seeing us get better over time.
Well, Laen may not be a traitor, but she still wants to keep me from singing at the handfast! And look at this harp! Those beasts nearly destroyed it.
Don't take too long with him.
This is an unmitigated disaster. What is the Queen thinking?
One day, over a drink, you must tell me what happened down there. For now, the Queen's safety is my primary concern.
It seems no tale ever truly ends. The characters change, but the tale goes on.\n\nNow, we must fulfill our roles.
Luxuries and delicacies from the far-off land of Elsweyr! What is your pleasure today?
So you found the peak. You'll not live to tell of your discovery!
So much of my past is now a scorched ruin.\n\nIt is yet another reason to hate Molag Bal and his twisted minions.
All that live must die someday. Perhaps this is my day.
Four years. I've been at this party for four years. The Argonian body wasn't meant to take this kind of abuse. But every time I try to leave, someone shoves a bottle at me. And here I stay.
Hanilan, of the First Auridon Marines, at your service.
Defeat <<1>> and we'll scatter the Worm Cult to the four winds.
Do you really think we can kill <<1>>?
Come quickly! They took Honorable Eraral-dro!
Help defeat <<1>>. I'm counting on you!
Is it true? The barrier is down? We're one step closer to reclaiming Firsthold!
I heard the barrier is down. We're one step closer to reclaiming Firsthold!
Razum-dar mentioned he would speak with you. Seek him out and return to the Queen once you're done.
We're back! The High Kinlord is safe and Queen Ayrenn's alliance is secure.\n\nNot bad for a day's work.
If any of those haughty High Elves don't fancy a drink … well, you may have to be a bit more insistent.
Enjoying the party, fellow Ebonheart Pact citizen?
What do you want?
Oh, hello. You're going to hurt me, aren't you?
The Queen received word of your impressive efforts in Silsailen. You're all she can talk about.
Master Pellingare wouldn't believe me when I told him his son and daughter were plotting to attack this city.\n\nHe no longer has a choice.
Word is, you've won a few fights. Good work.
Ahh, a true fighter! Well fought.
That was some display. Ysgramor's strength!
Music has its place, though I prefer the spoken word.
I knew this lousy job wasn't over. Must I sling more libations for my captors?
No one moves. They should be dancing.
What's with all the dialog? The people demand music!
Both of us are best served by never mentioning Bar-Neeus's name again.
This one knew you were a winner. That's why this one bet so much money on you!\n\nTake it as a compliment.
You said you left him bound in the mine, right?
I thank the Stars I found that book on salloweed. Without it, we'd have no defense against this wretched disease.
Please, we're very busy here. Give us some room.
Wha? What are you doing talking to me? Get going!
You've done me a great favor. I sense a change in the wind in Riften, thanks to you.
This is it. Have you found the answer yet? So close. So close.
I don't think we will ever feel safe here again.
She looks hurt, champion. See to her.
Estre dead. Rilis found. Razum-dar couldn't have asked for more. \n\nEven this one must admit: you do good work. Without you leading the charge, today could have gone very differently.
I hope you can find them. Ayrenn, the Queen. She'll be so worried.
Thanks! Those cultists really got to me. I'll be ready for them next time!
<<1>>. What can I say? She was nuts. All those cultists are. I wanna kill every one of them, in the most painful ways possible. Sounds like a plan, right?
Welcome to Nimalten, traveler. Do you seek the council of our mighty Thane Fjora? Or are you here with Sergeant Aera's contingent?
Well met. Your stride carries you with purpose. Are you part of Sergeant Aera's squad?
The hero of Bal Foyen returns! What news?
What are you doing here, scum?
Did you swoon? I would have swooned.
I can't believe you told her.
I know he's doing good work. But Stars do I wish Hendil would give me back my barn.
If you ask me, this plague is sent by Auri-El. Cull out some of these useless layabouts. Make the town more habitable.
All the good hands got themselves sick. So all the repairs fall to me. Just great.
Excellent. I hope this works.
I'm eager to see this plan in action.
I hope Sinien's plan works. Auri-El watch over you.
I should be able to help with the ritual. Damn it.
I hardly know what to do next, with all that's happened in the last few days.
I thought Arkay would come for me today.
How could you? How could you?
Ah, you must be the one everyone is talking about. It's good to see you've returned. I wasn't sure I could keep the Queen detained much longer.
So. It's finally over.
Not bad, not bad. Not that impressive, either.\n\nIf you really want to prove yourself—
Grab a mug! Get drinking.
You sick? No? Then get out of here.
Hmph. Quite the busybody about town, aren't you?
Please don't disturb us.
Another round of drinks! Another song!\n\nAha! And I see I have another ardent admirer.
Tell the Canonreeve what this slime has done.
Please, just leave me. Don't look at me.
Next time I see Worm Cultists, they're dead!
With the lich dead, we are all needed elsewhere. Keep your teeth sharp, friend.
Ha! You settled their hash, didn't you? You'll always be welcome around our campfires.
Mages, eh? Such strange creatures. But other than a little bit of stiffness in my neck, I'm no worse the wear for being a lawn ornamentation.
You ready for this?
Glad you made it out, Arrow. I'll make sure Dajaheel and Belron go up on the rolls in Mournhold. It's mad to think of all those people. Reduced to ink on parchment.
I suppose <<1>> wasn't as big a fool as I'd thought.
Well? Where's my share of the treasure? We need to head out before the tide turns again.
Is Rilyn dead? \n\nOh, this is all my fault. My parents forbade me to see him, but I ignored them. I caused their deaths!
Dunmer bastard snuck up on me. Gutted me like a horker. \n\nGo after him, save Raerana! He'll kill her if she doesn't go with him.
Helping Hendil. No concern for yourself in the face of plague. Admirable. Very admirable.
Heard you managed to get some more of that alchemy goo. Know a few people that will appreciate that.
This plague is a scourge from the mongrels, I just know it. They're nothing but reservoirs of disease and mange.

We saw—and heard—so much! I can't believe anyone thought she could bring back the Walking City on her own! Or that she thought it was taken to Oblivion.\n\nEveryone knows the city rests beneath the great sea until its time to rise!
Looks like you've done some good work here.
Where's <<1>>? Don't tell me you left her at the dragonshrine!
Let's go!
Sure glad you showed up. Those cultists are nasty customers.
Don't think you can dissuade me. My mind is made up!
Get going. Heldil can't hold him long.
Now that you're here, I'll ask you to check in with the Watch Captain. We're sending all newcomers to speak with her. Astanya's on the docks. Southeast end of the city.
Right. Now that you've passed this along, I'll need to ask you to make for the docks. As a newcomer to the city, the Watch Captain will want to note your arrival.
What happens in the mine? This waiting wears on me.
I do hope she hasn't lost sight of her duties. That woman is too easily flustered.
Keep moving.
The Daggers. They're here. They followed us home!
The days and nights all blur together now.
The Prophet's enclosure isn't far. Let's go!
All of Auridon knows the Veiled Queen is a traitor—but a Daedra worshiper, as well! A High Elf in league with Dagon himself.
Seek out the Cultist Summoner atop the dais. The evil flows from there.
I'm sorry, I can't help you right now. I'm very busy and there's a lot to do.
Good work, citizen. Glad the captain sent you our way.
What did you find?
Now to look to larger things. I must cement my position, and continue my tour of the isle.
This is it. Last one! What do you say, going to try to puzzle it out yourself?
You're awake now, sleeping kitten?
You saved <<1>> and <<2>> itself. You have our eternal gratitude, my friend.
Well. At least Tanamo is back. Good, reliable Tanamo.\n\nWhere are the rest of them?
This one can't afford to be caught unprepared. <<1>> will train. Until the Maormer are no longer a source of fear.
I feel terrible. And how is it I'm the one that's managed to show up? Lorkhan's luck.
Not now… I must concentrate…
I never should have left. Nothing like good solid ground.
Did you find <<1>>?
With you taking care of Varnedo, I can relax a bit. \n\nMight see if those Nords really know how to drink.
You have questions, new friend?
So, everything work out all right?
I'm resting up. Talk to me another time.
Hello.
You. You're not with them? Quickly, get me out of here!
Remember. No is not an acceptable answer.
Quickly, take the side tunnel to return to the entrance!
You've returned! I thank you again for your help.\n\nTwo-Blades would like to speak with you.
You arrived just in time.
Be wary, traveler. This corruption could take you, too!
Find my father, outsider. And the rest of the villagers, too.
This one has no time for talk now. I must tend to this poor man. Though I fear with the reagents I have on hand… there may be little more I can do.
Hope it's going well for you.
Oh, dear! Did my champion lose his nerve? Please, you must stop Cracktooth!
How goes the stealing of the blades? Don't let me down.
Greetings. What can I do for you?
Oh, I hope they are safe.
Did you find my boy, Ulfslod?
They're stocking something in the hut off to the west. Might be worth checking out.
Lodorr's Crown isn't here.
Woo-hoo!
I need another drink. Let's find my friends and get out of this accursed place.
I see you've found one of my friends. Good to know they haven't all been eaten.
You should have seen the fish I almost caught. It was a small whale.
You have the pleasure of speaking with High Kinlady Estre, scion of royal Aldmeri blood. I must apologize, but my escort and I were just in the middle of a conversation. If you'll excuse us?
Bit busy here, if you don't mind?
Welcome to Vulkhel Guard!
A very fitting look for you.
I saw those three drunkards stumble out of here. I assume you had something to do with that. Should have left them to the Draugr if you ask me. \n\nBut I guess you didn't ask me, did you?
That's the end of the coven, but we still need to get out of here.
Could it be I made the wrong choice?
Eranamo was a good mer. He only wanted to do what he thought was right in his heart.
Right. Now we can go find my sister.
My daughter doesn't deserve this fate!
The voice could've lied about everything. But if I don't try, we'll both be cursed.\n\nShe's in such a daze. I'd hate for her to know what's happening right now.
It's great to meet you at the gate again. Just like the last time!
Estre must pay for this.
Ah, good. Raz was beginning to worry about you.
Zaban. What happened here, damn it?
Have you finished your tour yet? Make sure to have a run at some of the students. Can't have you telling the Queen we're slacking.
Sorry. Can't talk.
Bravely done.
Let's show these Bloodthorn cultists what for!
What I am going to do with that fool Orc. He'll never make it in the Lion Guard.

Two altars broken and still I can sense the Canonreeve's magic. There must be one remaining. Find it and you may find <<1>>.\n\nBe wary if you do—her power has grown immensely if these altars are any indication.
There are two loyal soldiers and one traitor out there. I need you to sort them out!
Hurry it up, will you?
You're freeing us? Are you going to free me, too?
I may have exaggerated a bit. My apologies.
Hurry, please. They could be back any minute!
Greetings. Did Baham send you to this one?
That went better than expected. Now, just do your part ….
Students always complain about our difficult curriculum.\n\nOf course it's difficult! This is Shad Astula, not the Mages Guild.
Just don't snort the cinnamon. That's bad for you.
Don't stand here with your mouth open. Go!
Reinforcements are on the way. Move. We need that thing up.
I can't believe this is happening to me.
You've come to test your mind? Learn if you have what it takes?
It's only a matter of time before we take the fight to Daggerfall, mark my words.
Thank you. One day, perhaps Ilara's dreams will return. Return to normal.
Good work. You're tougher than you look.
Why did you come here? Velian will kill you.
I've dosed Len with enough healing potion so that he'll sleep for hours. Once he's feeling better, these rogues better be gone.\n\nOtherwise, he'll just try to fight them again.
Congratulations, you beat up some weaklings.
Well. You've got some backbone. Good for you.

Those Bloodthorn cultists ran out of the village like a Dragon was chasing them! Glad we had our weapons ready. We cut them down without breaking a sweat.\n\nDame Clarique wants to know what happened in there when you get a chance.
They'll get what's coming to them, one way or another.
I'm very grateful for your help. I wanted to help these people, but I couldn't have done it without you.
Here we are. The very embodiment of the Green Lady can be see in this ancient tree.
Fair day! I've been given instructions. Razum-dar needs to speak with you, at once.
Ah, Lyris. Bit of an idealist, that one. Says she's determined to save us all from eternal torment. Heart's in the right place, I suppose, but the girl's as mad as Sheogorath's jammies.
The captain sent you? Thank Mara.
I hope we're in time.
Take another look into the rooms before you head down into the library. If there are illusion spells, you'll need every edge you can get.
Were you able to find some petals from Kyne's Tears? They are so hard to find.

As I feared, we arrived in different locations. I am in a place with the smell of burning ash on a hot wind and the sounds of a distant battle. \n\nIt matters not. You have awakened once again and we must set you on your path.
Find the leader of the side you have chosen and present yourself. I'm eager to see how the game plays out with you involved.
Did you speak to Nelhilda? Smart lass, my daughter. Very smart.

If you're looking for work, there's better to be had elsewhere. The forge is suited for the lesser races, particularly those cats. \n\nAlmost hate to see the Bosmer work the forge. Mer should stick by mer.
Once I destroy the wards, we can get inside the vault. No problems after that. I'm sure!
Sithis blind me! Be there other living mortals in this wretched waste? You're the first swab I've seen who still has meat on their bones.
Thanks for the bait. Maybe them fish will start biting now.
I wouldn't go into town if I were you. Just keep on to Firsthold.
I hope he's all right.
Me crew is dead. Looks like we be the only living things left in this wretched place.
If you keep the Admiral distracted, I'll convince his crew to join with me … er … us. Without a crew, a captain is powerless.\n\nExcept for me, of course.
Excuse me, please. I must look for her ring. Can't leave without it.
You're a stubborn one, mate, I'll give you that.
I know a few of the House Hlaalu guards. I heard how you helped them find a cure for the plague.
Enter the portal and find the source of the power I sense emanating from the other side.
Please find my husband! His name is Pirtar. He was still in the house when the roof fell in!
The attack was so sudden. We barely made it out alive.
The Daedra. Everywhere. Damn those things are fast.
Thank the Eight! Please tell me the Marines have arrived.
Thank the Divines I found you. \n\nYou need to find Landare. She's in over her head.
I feel my strength returning. I should be as good as new in a few days.
The guards are quiet again. Something's happened.\n\nWhere's my son? Where's Sorondil?

Bernt gave my lute back. It feels right to have it in my hands again.\n\nI showed great promise when I was young and Bernt had it made for me. Sent all the way from Windhelm and made by the finest lute crafter in the land.
Why is … why is Angof helping me?\n\nWhat … what's going on here?
Are you mad? You decided to help Thallik? Willingly? How can you imagine that was a good idea?\n\nThis one hopes you know what you're doing.
<Raynor Vanos is sound asleep.>

I had friends and allies once. Companions who would never abandon me, no matter the cost. But that was before. Before I became this … monster.\n\nEnough! I must find the magic to restore my human form.
Hey there. Ever spend any time staring at your own corpse?\n\nI don't recommend it.
<Lady Laurent doesn't seem to hear you.>
Off with you. Off!\n\nSpill blood. Stab things. Do what you do best!
The shadow wanted my help, but I never asked what it wanted me to do. I … I just gave up.\n\nIf you can find the shadow, maybe we'll have a chance. I … I just don't know.
Defeat the champions of Angof and Thallik. Then we can have a proper celebration!\n\nAnd remember, should you need assistance, use my mask of shadows. I think you'll enjoy what happens after that.
I hope you're not here to kill Goblins. If you are, we'll have a problem.
You did it! You've returned my crewmates! My friends.
I hope that our warriors are strong enough to aid you in the coming battle.
You are interfering. The fate of the old tavern keeper and his patrons is none of your concern.
It's been years since I spilled blood in the field. Ah, the memories.
You look to be young and able. Please say you'll help.\n\nThe Nurin farm has been burned down and Mister Nurin has disappeared. It's very serious.
I feel sorry for Rosalie, but there's nothing more these old bones can do.\n\nI only stayed on the farm these last few years for William's sake, and I hate to say it, but I think he died in the fire.
I failed.
If I lose my pack beasts and all my money, I'm doomed. I might as well die here.
Your valiant rescue of the First Auridon Marines was well-timed. They've driven off the last of the imposters.\n\nWhat news of the traitor, Teldur? Was Canonreeve Valano injured?
Masterful! Did you take dance lessons, or are you naturally graceful?\n\nI suppose I shouldn't tease. You did much better than I would have. I'm sure <<1>> will appreciate your hard work.
Return once you've convinced Drulis to do his job. If he won't, perhaps you'd undertake it.
We just need to hold a little longer.
I knew Nelhilda would hate me for this.\n\nI almost said I would give anything for her forgiveness, but I've learned the dangers of making wishes.
We'll keep the pirates off your tail, I swear it!
They attacked the lighthouse? But why? That doesn't make any sense.\n\nCan I see these plans?
You're a clever one. I figured this would all end in bloodshed. Turning an Orc's wounded pride against him is no easy task.
We'll distract the pirates while you slip into the Fighters Guild.\n\nHurry, before they can arm their undead with every weapon in that building.
Please, don't let her take me back! I'll give back the trinkets, but I can't go back!
She's my property, as surely as that locket is. But if you're determined to free her, there's nothing I can do about it. You're the one who's armed here, after all.
Is it done? Is <<1>> dead?
Ask questions later. You need to get spriggan bark so we can save your remaining friend.
Ifriz isn't in the Fighters Guild? I don't understand how I could have been so mistaken.

Watch out for Captain Angarthal—his axes are stained with the blood of more sailors than I can count. He's a monster. \n\nHey though. If you're feeling tough, I say take that bastard out. Won't hear any complaints from me.
It's all my fault. We wouldn't be out here if it weren't for me.
He left a note? I don't know how to mix the ingredients!\n\nMaybe you can figure it out his word-play. There must be something in the way he described the ingredients. Take a look at his note again.
I have nothing to say to you.
Oh, hello. Guess I should've expected to see you around. Not that it isn't good to see you, but ….\n\nWhy are you here, exactly?
We have nothing to discuss. I'll meet you below.
What happened? Why did <<1>> sound so strange?
Sorry, but Master Tuunerol is currently away. I can't grant you access without his express permission.
The race is on!

It's … surprising to get help from a stranger out here. Thank you.\n\nThree journals should be enough. Knowing the whoreson dogs that live out here—I mean that literally—I'm assuming at least one was eaten or defecated on.
Uh, can I help you? Very busy here.
Can I help you? Just watching the races. Noting that Snooks is a superior specimen in almost every way.
What do you want? Look at you, weakling. Even my frog could rip you apart.
It should be easy to grab those baubles and get back before anyone's the wiser.
A mother shouldn't outlive her children. And I've had four pass on to Aetherius. It's almost too much to bear.
Vox is defeated, order is restored. You are a credit to your people.
Use the list to track them down. Good luck, and show no mercy.
<<1>> is a lovestruck fool. At least she didn't get anyone killed.
What is it now?
Bandits rushed the gates and scaled the walls. There's not enough of us to drive them back!
A fellow seeker of knowledge! I can tell by the glint in your eye. <<AC:1>> is a marvelous find, is it not?
You don't fool me! It looks like you're helping us, but I know you must be up to something.\n\nJust remember that I'm keeping my eye on you.
Statues with living eyes. They were always watching! And the bones ….
Ah, my arms! I thought they were going to fall off.\n\nI'm glad the eyeball was worth it. So good when a theory works in practice, you know?
Ah! Stay back, pirate!
Who are these Pact-soldiers? Are they merciful new friend's allies? <<1>> hopes they come to stop <<2>>!
We're under attack!
Well, did you add our special ingredient to the Imperials' food?
Hello, murderous. We both expect to see you at the estate. \n\nYou don't want to disappoint us, do you?
As mud is my mother, what is the Canonreeve planning?\n\nThe air is tinged with an aura of magic I've never felt before.
What an obscure ritual. I've never seen its like. Seems Bakkhara was right, and the Canonreeve is no mere politician.\n\nPerhaps I wasn't wasted on this mission after all.
You need something. I can tell.

Welcome to Sentinel, grunt. I wish I could have gotten some of that action on the docks. But, you know—politics. \n\nTake a moment to look around. We've got all the tools of the trade. Point one out and we'll make a deal.
Be quiet! That thing might hear! We can speak after it's gone.
Now that Vox no longer threatens us, I'm sure things will return to normal.
As you see, Headman Bhosek's trust in my skills was not misplaced. Nor was my faith in your prowess.\n\nWill you assist me on another task?
The traitors lost their fight once you killed <<1>>. I'd rather hang the lot of them, but <<2>> said some were coerced into it.\n\nEven so, they'll need some kind of punishment.
Yes? Is it done?
Auri-El watch your steps. I'm very excited about this project. Shalidor's sanctuary would be a boon to every mage in Tamriel. Even Guildmaster Vanus approves of our work here!
If there's anything consistent about Sheogorath, it's his knack for surprises. \n\nCome. Let's return to Valaste now that you've recovered the second book.
Are you still on the first act? Very good. A true professional always prolongs the first act.

I hope that Goblin chief understands your generosity in sparing him. We'll take charge from here. With any luck, we can relocate Koth and his tribe.\n\nAnd thank you for dealing with Nelanya so I wouldn't have to. I've found quite the boon in you.
The mutiny's over? He's dead?\n\nOh, it's done! I think I need to sit down.
How did it go, dearie? The faithful have been served at Baan Dar's bar, yes?
Be on guard if you're headed up to the castle. King Fahara'jad's army is camped outside the walls.\n\nThey claim they're here in a diplomatic capacity, but I'm not buying it.
Byz not get in way! Let Byz alone!
So you haven't been briefed? News travels slower than honeymead in the field.
Are you expecting me to fetch it for you? I'm no servant of yours, mortal.
You! You're the one who rescued me from those slavers in Koeglin. \n\nI can't thank you enough. They would have killed me for certain.
What you want? Go away!
Shazah and I rarely agree on anything. But your role in the Dance … this could be important. Not important like the monks and their books. Actually important.
You're not changing your mind, are you? Please don't!
You look like you know something of my father. Tell me.
If it isn't too much trouble, would you bring me the skulls of the Imperial mages? It will allow me to stop the ritual that sustains me in this terrible fashion.
Shazah wasn't sure to believe you … couldn't believe you. But it is true. You are the Moon Hallowed!
This is very exciting!
My "husband," Quintus Verres, is around here somewhere. He's got every scrap of research I've done on these ruins and the Guardian's Eye. I need my materials back.
If you are wounded, you may take a bed in the corner. I will tend to you as soon as I can.
Can you get the sword for me? I'll prepare the stinking flesh needed to lure out the beast. It's Mother's special recipe.
You're back. Good. Do you know what this cult is planning?
Ugh. My head thanks you for your haste. Once the barrier fell, whatever she was doing stopped as well!
It was horrible. They descended like wolves.\n\nIf Dark hadn't been with me, I don't want to imagine what they might have done.
I am to protect Eling at any cost. I did not fail. \n\nThe bandits made off with some of our goods, but Eling is uninjured. That is what is important.
You aren't a cultist, are you? Please. Help me! They took me from my tribe!
Hello to you, Aniel's friend. This one wishes we had brought more moon-sugar with us. Roasts always taste better lathered in sweet.
I'm not proud of what we've decided to do, but we might as well get it over with.
A bit rusty, but not bad! So funny, watching you mortals muck around with things you can't possibly understand.\n\nI'll be needing that back, now.
As I expected. <<1>> is hiding something, but I don't know what.\n\nGood thing we've already planned for this. Are you ready for a little subterfuge?
Can't wait to see the look on <<1>>'s face when I prank her this year.\n\nHello there, stranger! Having fun at the festival?
You have the <<1>>? This is going to be amazing!
Quick, follow him! Don't lose the courier!\n\nYou've got to be the first person to find him when the poison takes hold. I'll meet you at the farm.
